description: A young man films himself with an outstretched arm on a small country railway platform while an orange and grey train pulls in behind him on the rails; he is holding a croissant. The shot cuts to him walking through a busy indoor railway station under big departure boards, commuters and rolling suitcases around him and the croissant in his mouth. He ends alone on a wide platform under a huge arched glass roof, tracks running away on both sides, looking up into the light.

taps.phrase: to gaze up at the roof
